content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight-adjacent","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"fight"}},{"id":"navigate-to-ladder","priority":1,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"gte","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"climb-mine"}}],"skills":[{"name":"climb-mine","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { let p = await b.body(); if (p.x===11 && p.y===1) break; const ms = await b.monsters(); const adj = ms.find(m => Math.abs(m.x-p.x)<=1 && Math.abs(m.y-p.y)<=1); if (adj) { await b.faceAndPress(adj.x, adj.y, 'ControllerX', 0); await b.wait(300); p = await b.body(); } const r = await b.walkTo(x, y, 'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); await b.wait(150); } } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"},{"name":"fight","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const adj = ms.find(m => Math.abs(m.x-p.x)<=1 && Math.abs(m.y-p.y)<=1); if (adj) { await b.faceAndPress(adj.x, adj.y, 'ControllerX', 0); await b.wait(300); } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'fought'})"}]}
